The '''Otunia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Bosph sector/Legends|Bosph sector]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Otunia]].
